fact: On 9 December 2023 in Lome the regulators of Mali, Benin and Togo signed bilateral free-roaming protocols under ECOWAS regulation C/REG.21/12/17, to take effect by 29 February 2024 with free incoming calls for 30 days.
title: Signature de protocoles d’accord bilatéraux de free roaming entre le Mali et le Bénin et le Togo et le Mali
